Read .pli data to sf_linestring

readPli.Rd

This function can read file in Deltares-polyline format with or without Z values and convert it to a sf LINESTRING.

Usage

readPli(path, crs = sf::NA_crs_)

Arguments

path

Path to the .pli file (only x, y)

crs

Coordinate system of the polyline, eg. crs = "EPSG:25833"

Value

sf_linestring

Examples

# read .pli file
# with cross sections of Elbe river (x and y)
file <- system.file("testdata/Obs_cross_sections01_crs.pli", package = "ugrid")
# read without crs, CRS attribute is NA
readPli(file)

#> Geometry type: LINESTRING
#> Dimension:     XY
#> Bounding box:  xmin: 190703.3 ymin: 5833043 xmax: 300629.2 ymax: 5930442
#> CRS:           NA

#> 1        OCS01_Storkau LINESTRING (297772.7 583304...
#> 2      OCS03_Scharleuk LINESTRING (287654.8 587225...
#> 3    OCS04_Wittenberge LINESTRING (282525.3 587561...
#> 4    OCS05_Mueggendorf LINESTRING (275642.9 587844...
#> 5  OCS06_Schnackenburg LINESTRING (270427.6 588253...

#> 10     OCS11_Hitzacker LINESTRING (236151.4 589752...
# read with crs, CRS attribute has value
readPli(file, crs = "EPSG:25833")

# read .pliz file with kribben and kade (x y z)
file <- system.file("testdata/Buhnen_Deiche_v02_fxw.pliz", package="ugrid")
readPli(file, crs = "EPSG:25833")
